system.description:
You gain Climbing Expertise and while Climbing, you can freely run across walls as if you were Running, allowing you to keep your hands free while moving. Once you stop moving in this way, you can choose to immediately Cling if you are on Climbing Terrain.

When you use the Leap Action, you can add your Nimbleness to the Vertical distance you travel and your Strength to the Horizontal distance you travel.
